Container.Name: mcp-nametag-connector
Container.Overview: MCP connector for Nametag (personal relationship manager). Read-only by default: write access and destructive tools are separate switches. Port 8000, path /mcp, behind a bearer-token gateway. Needs a running Nametag and an API token created in Nametag under Settings, API Tokens.
Container.Requires: A running Nametag instance reachable over HTTP from this container.

Config.Name: NAMETAG_URL
Config.Description: Address of Nametag as seen from this container. Same Docker network: container name and internal port (http://nametag:3000). Different networks: Unraid IP and the published port of Nametag.

Config.Name: NAMETAG_API_TOKEN_FILE
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the file with the Nametag API token (ntag_...). Leave as is and set the host path below.

Config.Name: MCP_BEARER_TOKEN_FILE
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the file with the gateway bearer token. Leave as is and set the host path below.

Config.Name: NAMETAG_ENABLE_WRITE
Config.Description: false = read only. true enables the write tools (needs a READ_WRITE API token in Nametag).

Config.Name: NAMETAG_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE
Config.Description: true unlocks delete_person and merge_people. Only has an effect together with NAMETAG_ENABLE_WRITE=true.

Config.Name: Gateway bearer token file
Config.Description: Host file with the gateway bearer token (just the token text).

Config.Name: Nametag API token file
Config.Description: Host file with the Nametag API token (just the ntag_... text).
